text:
ravi: Heads up, FRA edge pool 2 intake flagged 3 H100s with coolant residue and thermal discoloration. Depot holding for RMA.

tara: Serials? photos?

ravi: Uploaded to ticket TKT-5102. Serials: H100-9001, H100-9002, H100-9003. Depot requests manifest + HS code for customs.

vendor-ops: We can do local refurb swap (24-48h) or factory express (next-day air). Express uplift ~€1,450/unit; refurb swap handling ~€120/unit.

ops-bot: incident created INC-2029-210 (FRA pool 2 thermal intake).

elaine: Capacity note: losing 3 units drops throughput ~12% for FRA. Recommend express for H100-9001 (critical route realtime-embed-ams) and refurb for the rest.

tara: Any uplift credit? We negotiated credits last quarter for manufacturing defects.

vendor-ops: Credit conditional on claim acceptance. I can request 35% uplift credit on the express unit if we provide 3-bullet RCA and bundle any further returns this quarter. Need AWB booked by EOD to lock next-day.

ravi: I'll prepare the manifest and 3-bullet RCA now. Tara can do drop at depot 08:00 CET tomorrow.

vendor-ops: Copy. Provisional AWB 550-FR-9001 created. Will update final AWB and credit approval by 17:00 CET.
